advanced.title: Advanced Stock Screener
advanced.subtitle: Comprehensive filtering + technical stock state identification (correction / recovery / peak / near breakout)
advanced.subtitleAuto: Comprehensive filtering + technical stock state identification — results auto-updated

stateDescriptions.recovery: RSI between 40-45 + above MA50 + up today — recovery signal after correction.
stateDescriptions.balancedMomentum: RSI between 55-65 + above MA50 — sustained healthy momentum.
stateDescriptions.nearBreak: Price near the average from below (within 2%) — poised for upward breakout.
stateDescriptions.atPeak: RSI ≥ 70 — overbought, may retreat after the peak.
stateDescriptions.neutral: RSI between 45-55 + adequate volume — awaiting a clear direction.
stateDescriptions.inCorrection: RSI < 40 + below MA50 — in correction phase. If RSI < 30 and near 52-week low → oversold (may rebound).
stateDescriptions.stillFalling: RSI < 40 + below MA50 + down today — still declining.
stateDescriptions.insufficientData: Insufficient data for classification (RSI or MA50 missing) — data update required.

collapsible.stateHelpLabel: Explanation of the seven stock states

empty.noResults: No results match the current filters

filterHelp.market: Specifies the financial market (EGX = Egyptian Stock Exchange).
filterHelp.sector: Specifies the sector — choose from the list or All.
filterHelp.volume: Minimum daily trading volume (number of shares traded).
filterHelp.turnover: Minimum liquidity (trade value in EGP = price × volume).
filterHelp.trend: Daily change direction: up (> 0), down (< 0), or neutral (~ 0).
filterHelp.aboveMa: Above moving average: MA50 (short-term), MA200 (long-term), or both.
filterHelp.rsi: Relative Strength Index: oversold < 30 (may rebound), overbought > 70 (may retreat).
filterHelp.volume_surge: Volume higher than 1.5× average volume — likely liquidity inflow.
filterHelp.near_52w_high: Price within 5% of 52-week high — near testing the peak.
filterHelp.near_52w_low: Price within 5% of 52-week low — near testing the bottom.
filterHelp.pe: Price-to-Earnings ratio (P/E): value range. Lower = relatively cheaper.
filterHelp.roe: Minimum return on equity (%) — higher = better efficiency.
filterHelp.stock_state: Technical stock state: see explanation next to each option.

footer.title: ℹ️ How does the exit radar work?
footer.body: The script scans all stocks daily across 5 exit paths (X1-X5). Signals are ordered by priority: X5 (Kill Switch) → X1 (strong distribution) → X4 (exhaustion gap) → X3 (resistance rejection) → X2 (volume divergence). Each stock appears with its highest achieved exit path. Source:

x1.label: Strong Distribution
x1.desc: Strong institutional selling — high volume with close in the lower half
x1.action: Full sell or strong position reduction

x2.label: Volume Divergence
x2.desc: Fake rally — price broke the peak but volume is weak
x2.action: Reduce half the position + tight stop

x3.label: Resistance Rejection
x3.desc: Tested resistance and closed with a long upper shadow
x3.action: Stop at last low + monitor breakout

x4.label: Exhaustion Gap
x4.desc: After a long rally, a gap up followed by a red close

x5.label: Kill Switch
x5.desc: Immediate exit signal (Limit Up Trap / fatal distribution)
